items.summary: Legal disposition: conditional for ordinary reversible fleet growth; evidence_needed for fleet-wide compliance and security clearance. Evidence includes compliance baseline 37 pass, 16 fail, 6 unknown; analytics broadly available with permission gaps; data quality green for registry and operational checkouts and yellow for analytics freshness and revenue attribution; revenue covers 2026-09-21 only with $4.92 aggregate commission and $0 site-attributed commission. Do not infer legal clearance, ROI, or site revenue. Continue only growth preserving consent, cookie and analytics disclosure, terms, affiliate disclosure, claims, provenance, rights, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and regulated or age-sensitive boundaries.

SearchWoot launch disposition: blocked for public beta or full launch; counsel_required for upstream data rights, jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment, vendor and DPA obligations, and future affiliate or advertising use. Exact decision: keep private. Official API access is documented, but rights to store, derive, cache, display, alert on, or monetize returned data are not established; current public terms point against the proposed use. Security, accuracy, freshness, attribution, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete. Keep external permission outreach unsent pending human-counsel and owner authorization.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks closed. Partial progress is evidenced by official source documentation and terms, repository and configuration data-flow files, privacy and cookie pages, and draft terms. No task is closable because authoritative rights, field-level provenance, operator-confirmed retention and user workflows, deployed consent and GA4 settings, log and vendor inventory, incident and request procedures, and human-counsel review remain incomplete. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only bundle containing the field-level rights matrix, alert and operational data flows, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification consent and unsubscribe behavior, GA4 configuration and retention, log fields, vendor and DPA coverage, and incident and request procedures. Do not send outreach or change the private gate.

Data-use dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data = blocked; user alert rules and sync results = evidence_needed; GA4 analytics = evidence_needed; operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data = evidence_needed. No go-live proposal is supported. Human counsel is required before any rights-dependent launch, public display, alert expansion, affiliate use, advertising use, or jurisdiction-specific privacy decision.

Retain existing measurement, attribution reconciliation, failure repair-or-close review, and bounded legal and security evidence work. Create no new production requests, requeues, experiments, telemetry requests, spend, monetization expansion, or external outreach. Incomplete telemetry alone is not a blocker for ordinary growth, but unsupported claims, rights-dependent reuse, privacy expansion, and security-sensitive exposure remain blocked or counsel_required.
